title: Skip the line?
text: We were waiting for years to visit Sagrada Familia of Barcelona, finally this tour was amazing we had an opportunity to catch up the best possible view, long queues to enter the main entrance that was the worst part, what we call it skip the line but skip the line itself is a matter of concern no difference between skip the line or in the line. Somehow, we managed to enter we forgot all the hassles, we started enjoying every bit of it.
author: stiffanym2024

title: Great experience!!
text: It was outstanding!! the tour was value for money, They did their best to provide us the beautiful view of the Sagrada Familia, overall experience was good we have enjoyed every bit of it.
author: tam0rk
